pt.headline: Ondas perfeitas e vento leve em Arrifana – surfe de qualidade!
pt.advice: Arrifana apresenta ondas de 1,6 m com período de 12 s e vento suave de 4 kt, ideal para manobras. Aviso à navegação costeira ANAV NR 2/22 (Plano de Salvamento Marítimo Lagos) está em vigor na zona, então respeite as áreas de segurança. Vista um fato 3/2 mm para a água de 17,9 °C e aproveite o swell antes que a praia fique cheia.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue cedo, antes das 09h, para evitar o pico de surfistas.

en.headline: Perfect waves and light wind at Arrifana – quality surf!
en.advice: Arrifana offers 1.6 m waves with a 12 s period and a gentle 4‑kt wind, perfect for maneuvers. Coastal navigation warning ANAV NR 2/22 (Lagos Maritime Rescue Plan) is active, so stay clear of restricted zones. Wear a 3/2 mm wetsuit for the 17.9 °C water and hit the swell before the beach fills up.
en.crowdTip: Get there early, before 9 am, to beat the crowd.

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.ptReason: Vento leve, boas ondas e menos aglomeração; aviso costeiro simples.
spots.enReason: Light wind, solid waves and lower crowd; only a simple coastal warning.

spots.name: Nazaré
spots.ptReason: Ondas maiores (2,1 m) e vento moderado; ideal para quem busca mais potência.
spots.enReason: Larger waves (2.1 m) with moderate wind; great for surfers after a stronger swell.

spots.name: Carcavelos
spots.ptReason: Vento muito fraco, mas muitas advertências e provável grande público.
spots.enReason: Very light wind, but several marine warnings and likely heavy crowd.

spots.name: Guincho
spots.ptReason: Ondas boas, mas vento de 8 kt e dois avisos costeiros tornam a sessão menos confortável.
spots.enReason: Good waves, but 8‑kt wind and two coastal warnings make it less comfortable.

spots.name: Supertubos
spots.ptReason: Ondas consistentes, porém vento forte (10 kt) e múltiplos avisos costeiros.
spots.enReason: Consistent waves, but strong wind (10 kt) and multiple coastal warnings.

spots.enReason: 1.9 m waves with light wind; however there is a marine‑animal sighting warning.
